periods.time: Night of the fifth day at Fifth Camp

name.zh: 多多良讲述暗狱之家与恶之华目标
name.en: Tatara Reveals Up Grund Past and Dirty Rose Goal

periods.location: Improvised hot spring at Fifth Camp, Edelberg
periods.summary: While bathing after five days of defense, Stella thanks Tatara and offers a reward. Tatara explains her childhood in the assassin family Up Grund, where chocolate was the only reward for successful work, and says she wants neither free sweets nor sympathy. Her desired payment is the right to kill Dirty Rose, who betrayed Up Grund and damaged its professional reputation. Stella accepts Tatara's chosen path and warns her not to lose, promising an unwanted grand funeral if she dies.
periods.cause: Stella wants to repay Tatara's advice, and Tatara wants her war objective recognized before the representative battle.
periods.process: Tatara describes assassin training, poison, survival training, and selection; she rejects the idea of revenge or quitting because she chooses to live and die as a professional assassin; Stella responds by offering a victory banquet cake and emotional pressure to survive.
periods.outcome: Tatara's motive to fight Ein is clarified, and Stella and Tatara's hostile relationship gains mutual recognition.
periods.significance: Humanizes Tatara and ties her assassin pride to the representative-war matchup against Dirty Rose.
